interfaces.events: declared task classes: full / uplink / short; gate threshold 3600 mV, stale window 60 s, 3 transport retries, offline queue depth 1
interfaces.frame: 16 bytes: A5 5A | seq | kind+flag | wind_hz u16 | rail_mv u16 | gas u16 | temp i16 cdegC | press u16 hPa*10 | flags | CRC-8
interfaces.freestanding_note: fixed L031 executor links without libc; rt_support.c supplies memset/memcpy/memmove/memcmp emitted by the compiler for clear/copy loops (previous build: undefined reference to memset/memcpy)
interfaces.init_status_r13: clock_setup() and adc_init() return a boot status; main() hard-stops (no sensors, no packing, no transport) if either fails. adc_init() enables the ADC regulator, runs ADCAL before ADEN, sets ADC_CCR.VREFEN plus SYSCFG_CFGR3.ENBUF_VREFINT_ADC, waits PWR_CSR.VREFINTRDYF, and a failed VREFINT/rail conversion returns 'unknown' (-1) instead of the nominal 3300 mV
interfaces.init_timing_gap: HSI16 start-up and ADC regulator/reference start-up times are datasheet/RM values not present in this workspace; the waits are declared bounds (ADC_VREG_STAB_MS, TIMEOUT_LOOPS) and are UNVERIFIED on silicon
interfaces.load_source: declared, NOT paper data: the paper names no MCU and publishes no node firmware; policy numbers live in app.h and are engineering declarations

pins.PA2: USART2_TX (stands in for the LoRa uplink)
pins.unused: PA4-PA8, PA11-PA15 not used by this firmware

interfaces.polarity: UVLO active low rail (<3600 mV aborts the task, no radio burst); I2C/UART polled, bounded
interfaces.rail_admission_r13: the rail is re-read immediately before EVERY transport call, first attempt after PACK and every retry: rail < 3600 mV or unreadable (<0 = unknown) blocks the transfer, keeps the packed/queued frame byte-identical, does not consume the 8-bit sequence number, and is never reported as a successful uplink (offline queue depth 1 drains first)
interfaces.transport: UART2 9600 8N1 replaces the paper's LoRa uplink at the application boundary; the radio physical layer is not implemented or verified
